light: Alaska fjord with cirrus: bright blue sky and still water keep the light panel legible.
dark: Frozen-lake salt polygons at blue dusk: deep blue and near-black give the dark taskbar a calm backdrop.
openkylin.why: Cool blue fjord/lake reflection echoes UKUI's daybreak-blue brand without an illustrated gradient.

light: Lake Wakatipu road and cirrus: blue, saturated, clear sky area above the bottom islands.
dark: Starlit snow peaks with mist: dark foreground under the islands keeps them readable.
openkylin-islands.why: Floating island taskbar over saturated, high-clarity scenery.

light: Mount Cook at lavender-pink alpenglow: soft violet sky, bright snow peak, low-key foreground.
dark: Rose-violet dusk over dark peaks; low-key lower half suits the dark fashion theme.
openkylin-heyin.why: HeYin's purple accent set against rose/violet dusk light.

light: Hazy teal lake and islands: low contrast, flat surfaces for the square Classic chrome.
dark: Long-exposure slate lake under heavy cloud: neutral and quiet.
openkylin-classic.why: Classic (启典) ships a water wallpaper; calm photographic water continues that role.

light: Pukaki-blue river at dawn: azure water matches the #3790FA brand.
dark: Starry snow slope in deep blue: the dark taskbar sits over a quiet foreground.
openkylin-light-seeking.why: Light-Seeking (寻光) is the azure brand colour; blue water and night sky photography.
